d:
Bihar Leader of the Opposition Tejashwi Yadav launched a sharp attack on the BJP, calling the government “illegitimate” and accusing those in power of undermining democracy with the help of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar.
Speaking in Delhi, Tejashwi also called for stronger opposition unity, saying the fight against Gyanesh Kumar would continue until action was taken against him.
He also spoke about Congress leader Sonia Gandhi’s meeting with RJD chief Lalu Prasad Yadav at Misa Bharti’s residence, highlighting the longstanding relationship between the Gandhi and Yadav families.
